tvShow.name: Gullak
tvShow.overview: Set in quaint by-lanes in the heart of India, Gullak is a collection of disarming and relatable tales of the Mishra family.

episodes.name: Tehri
episodes.overview: A sweet and sour tiff between mother-son projects the disappointments that both have against each other. The mother worries that her son is jobless and dislikes her son fussing about the food not being served. Stay tuned to know how this family goes about their uniqueness.

episodes.name: Hum Do Humare Do
episodes.overview: Both the brothers fight over the volume of the television. Aman requests his mother to convince Annu to make a drawing for his practical exam, starting another argument.

episodes.name: Itwaar
episodes.overview: On a not-so-good Sunday morning, Annu's mother wakes up to the alarm ringing. With the arrival of Sunday, most middle class families plan to make it special. Watch to know more about how special is their Sunday!

episodes.name: Batti Aa Gayi
episodes.overview: Aman enquires about Annu who hasn't returned home till late. Annu's father is relaxed while waiting for him. Annu returns to only demand for a scooty, making up excuses for being late.

episodes.name: Tyohaar
episodes.overview: It's Raksha Bandhan. Shanti falls sick but has to work all day. Annu shares his exam results with Aman, so he suggests him to run away. Shanti falls unconscious on hearing about Annu's exam results.

episodes.name: Bijlee Ka Bill
episodes.overview: Mishra house has received an inflated electricity bill. While a lot of speculation goes into how the bill has exceeded all limits, it is revealed that this problem has struck other households in the colony too. This turns out to be a great oppurunity for Santosh Mishra to make some extra money and fulfil a few family dreams.

episodes.name: Cheeni Kam, Paani Zyaada
episodes.overview: Shanti Mishra is dragged to a free medical camp by Bittu ki mummy and is surprised that she has been diagnosed with diabetes. There is a kitty party round the corner which has already been planned and Mummy is in no mood to cancel the same. Mishra ji realises this and says that the boys will do the preparation.

episodes.name: Saparivaar
episodes.overview: Annu gets a call where he is summoned to Pinky Mama's house for 2 weeks as his daughter Raanu is getting married. The entire family gets excited and starts preparing. But the excitement disappears soon when the wedding card arrives and it doesn't mention 'Saparivaar'.

episodes.name: Kal Board Ka Paper Hai
episodes.overview: Annu organises a cricket match screening at Prinsu, the Nagar Palika election candidate's bungalow, hoping to get a gas agency license in return. Mishra Ji joins the gathering. Meanwhile, Aman despite being told to study for his board exams, decides to sneak into the screening.

episodes.name: Kiraana
episodes.overview: D day for Mishra family. Today is the day Annu is supposed to get his gas agency license and Aman gets his board results. A big day for them both.

episodes.name: Mission Admission
episodes.overview: The Mishra family has grown in age, experience and comfort. Aman, the younger son, is now in plus two with big dreams while the elder son has his own desires. But when dreams and desires cross paths, Annu realizes that for his familial duties and responsibilities, some aspirations must wait.

episodes.name: LTA
episodes.overview: Just like every middle-class family, Santosh Mishra travels back home and aspires to use the LTA.

episodes.name: Agua
episodes.overview: Young Santosh Mishra had great expertise in fixing marriages. Santosh Mishra, an ex-Agua, is compelled to arrange a marriage that involves a young girl and her mother.

episodes.name: Satyanarayan Varta Katha
episodes.overview: Satyanarayan Varta Katha = The world where not everything goes according to plan. Be it education, promotion, or expectations. A family plagued with fears of failure takes steps.

episodes.name: Izzat Ki Chamkaar
episodes.overview: The Mishra Parivar is hit by health scare. It tries to come to terms with norms in the society we live in. Some members have deep realizations, some change their previously held notions, some grow up. The family experientially learns, loves, cares, bonds, and protects itself more than it ever did.

episodes.name: 'Kaaran Batau' Notice
episodes.overview: Annu faces a demanding new boss, while the Mishra family battles corruption, navigating the treacherous path between integrity and desperation in their struggle to save their home.

episodes.name: Chinaiti
episodes.overview: Shanti Mishra's trip to the temple turns tragic when a chain snatching incident traumatises her. Annu, Aman and Santosh have differing opinions regarding the incident.

episodes.name: Ghar Ka Kabaad
episodes.overview: The Mishra family embarks on clearing out the clutter from their home. The arrival of the scrap dealer in Mishra Nivas creates amusing challenges for the family that's divided on what to sell and what to retain.

episodes.name: Teesra Pahiya
episodes.overview: Annu faces challenges at work while Aman prepares to be the third wheel on Surya Narayan's date with a girl. Meanwhile, Santosh and Shanti are concerned about Aman's behaviour changing for the worse.

episodes.name: Pita, Putra aur Prempatra
episodes.overview: Annu navigates work pressures, while Aman's rebellion leads to a family conflict.

episodes.name: Putaai
episodes.overview: Santosh upgrades Mishra Niwas with fresh paint and Wi-Fi as Aman returns early from college in a new avatar. Amid these changes, Annu finds career growth after Shashi Ranjan's resignation.

episodes.name: Nakli Paneer
episodes.overview: An unexpected guest arrives at Mishra Niwas with gifts, sparking suspicion. Bittu Ki Mummy, now a vlogger, seeks the truth behind them, while Annu tries to impress Dr. Prithvi as his bond with Dr. Priti deepens.

episodes.name: Puncture Maar
episodes.overview: Shalini self-invites and hosts a Mahila Mandal at Mishra Niwas, unsettling Shanti. Meanwhile, Santosh's hopeful day turns chaotic as he faces an angry mob as the unlikely face of apology.

episodes.name: Akkal Daadh
episodes.overview: Annu takes Aman to Dr. Priti for his toothache despite his resistance, while Shanti and Santosh uncover Pinky Mama's true motive. Meanwhile, Papa nudges Bade Babu to repay old favors.

episodes.name: Striling - Puling
episodes.overview: Aman's troubling reason for returning early is revealed. Annu urges Dr. Priti to host a medical camp, Papa explores new housing, and Bittu Ki Mummy intrudes to film in Shanti's absence, crossing limits.

episodes.name: Svatantra Iccha
episodes.overview: Papa plans a joint home loan with Annu while the others step out. Aman follows Madhav's lead, Shanti makes a bold financial move, and Annu's altruistic endeavour comes at a major risk.

episodes.name: Kinkartavyavimudh
episodes.overview: Aman's shady dealings are exposed in a tense showdown at Mishra Niwas, leaving Santosh and Shanti stunned. As Annu and Dr. Priti's medical camp succeeds at a cost, the family questions their future.
